custom_checks.label: Public Articles API 含 total 欄位
Google OAuth client_id 有效
custom_checks.command: CSRF=$(curl -s -c /tmp/smoke-oauth-jar {{BASE_URL}}/api/auth/csrf | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['csrfToken'])") && GOOGLE_URL=$(curl -s -X POST -b /tmp/smoke-oauth-jar -c /tmp/smoke-oauth-jar -d "csrfToken=$CSRF" '{{BASE_URL}}/api/auth/signin/google' -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' --max-redirs 0 2>/dev/null) && GOOGLE_REDIRECT=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' "$GOOGLE_URL" 2>/dev/null) && echo "$GOOGLE_REDIRECT" | grep -qv 'oauth/error'; rm -f /tmp/smoke-oauth-jar

custom_checks.label: NextAuth providers 包含 google 和 line
custom_checks.command: curl -s {{BASE_URL}}/api/auth/providers | python3 -c "import sys,json; p=json.load(sys.stdin); assert 'google' in p, 'missing google'; assert 'line' in p, 'missing line'"

custom_checks.label: 主域名 /admin redirect 到 admin subdomain
Admin subdomain / redirect 到主域名
Admin subdomain /scores redirect 到主域名
Pageview API 接受 POST（回 200 或 400）
custom_checks.command: STATUS=$(curl -s -X POST -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"path":"/"}' '{{BASE_URL}}/api/public/pageview' 2>/dev/null) && ([ "$STATUS" = "200" ] || [ "$STATUS" = "400" ]) && echo '✓ pageview POST works' || echo "✗ pageview failed with $STATUS"

custom_checks.label: 批次發布 API endpoint 存在（POST /api/articles/generated/batch）
custom_checks.command: STATUS=$(curl -s -X POST -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"ids":[],"action":"publish"}' '{{BASE_URL}}/api/articles/generated/batch' 2>/dev/null) && ([ "$STATUS" = "401" ] || [ "$STATUS" = "200" ]) && echo '✓ endpoint exists (auth required or success)' || echo "✗ endpoint failed with $STATUS"
